out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: An employee was observed eating in food prep areas and near the hot service line.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT FOOD CANNOT BE EATEN IN AREAS WHERE FOOD PREP OR WHERE FOOD IS BEING SERVED FROM HOT WELLS AND THE REASONING AS TO WHY IS IT NOT ALLOWED. PIC DISCUSSED WITH EMPLOYEE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: Ice machine is in need of cleaning after EHS observed mold like substance build up inside.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PLEASE CLEAN THE ICE MACHINE BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: metal and plastic bowls without handles were being used as scoops to portion food.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PLEASE OBTAIN AND ONLY USE SCOOPS WITH HANDLES ON THEM TO PORTION FOOD TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: Cardboard was being used to line the shelving units in the walk-in refrigerator (2).
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY CARDBOARD IS NOT ALLOWED TO BE USED TO LINE SHELVING UNITS; AS IT IS NOT AN EASILY CLEANABLE SURFACE. PLEASE REMOVE CARDBOARD BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located to the left of the 3 vat sink is blocked by stacks of dirty dishes, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HAND SINKS CAN NEVER BE BLOCKED AND MUST ALWAYS BE ACCESSIBLE FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION OR A POTENTIAL FOOD BORNE ILLNESS. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE STDKS OF DIRTY DISHES.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Prepped and cut lettuce was being stored on the floor. Raw pork (Chicharrón) was being stored on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS EXPLAINED TO PIC WHY FOOD CAN NEVER BE STORED ON THE FLOOR. PIC MOVED BOTH THE LETTUCE AND PORK INTO THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR, ON A SHELVING UNIT 6 INCHES ABOVE THE GROUND.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walk-in refrigerator and the area where all the food is prepped is in need of a deep cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS DISCUSSED CLEANING PROCEDURES AND CLEANING FREQUENCY WITH PIC. PIC TOLD EHS THEY WILL CLEAN THE AREAS IN THE FACILITY BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.
